sections.heading: Symptoms
sections.text: Users cannot sign in after forgetting their password or the reset email does not arrive.

sections.heading: Resolution 1
sections.text: Open the sign-in page and select Forgot password, then enter the account email address.

sections.heading: Resolution 2
sections.text: Check the spam folder for the reset email; reset links expire after 30 minutes and a new link can be requested.

sections.heading: Symptoms
sections.text: SAML assertion errors or redirect loops appear when signing in through the identity provider.

sections.heading: Resolution 1
sections.text: In Admin settings open Authentication and upload the identity provider metadata XML file.

sections.heading: Resolution 2
sections.text: Confirm the ACS URL and entity ID match exactly, then enable SSO for the selected domains.

sections.heading: Symptoms
sections.text: Requests fail with 401 unauthorized after an API key is revoked or expires.

sections.heading: Resolution 1
sections.text: Open Developer settings, select API keys, and create a new key before revoking the old one.

sections.heading: Resolution 2
sections.text: Update the key in every client and environment variable, then revoke the old key.

sections.heading: Symptoms
sections.text: Requests fail with 429 too many requests during bursts of traffic.

sections.heading: Resolution 1
sections.text: Read the retry-after header and back off exponentially before retrying the request.

sections.heading: Resolution 2
sections.text: Batch requests where possible; higher rate limits are available on the pro and enterprise plans.

sections.heading: Symptoms
sections.text: Customers need a copy of their project data in CSV or JSON format.

sections.heading: Resolution 1
sections.text: Open Project settings, select Export, choose CSV or JSON, and start the export job.

sections.heading: Resolution 2
sections.text: A download link is emailed when the export completes; links remain valid for seven days.

sections.heading: Symptoms
sections.text: A deployment stops with a build error or health check timeout.

sections.heading: Resolution 1
sections.text: Open the deployment log and locate the first error line in the build step.

sections.heading: Resolution 2
sections.text: Verify the start command and health check path, then redeploy from the dashboard.

sections.heading: Symptoms
sections.text: Applications report connection refused or timeout errors to the managed database.

sections.heading: Resolution 1
sections.text: Add the application IP range to the database allow list under Networking.

sections.heading: Resolution 2
sections.text: Use the connection string from the database overview page and enable SSL mode require.

sections.heading: Symptoms
sections.text: Customers need to change a card, billing address, or download invoices.

sections.heading: Resolution 1
sections.text: Open Billing, select Payment methods, and add the new card before removing the old one.

sections.heading: Resolution 2
sections.text: Invoices can be downloaded from Billing history as PDF files.

sections.heading: Symptoms
sections.text: Customers ask where their data is stored and how to choose a region.

sections.heading: Resolution 1
sections.text: Choose the storage region when creating a project; available regions are listed in Project settings.

sections.heading: Resolution 2
sections.text: Existing projects cannot change region; create a new project in the target region and migrate data.

sections.heading: Symptoms
sections.text: Customers suspect unauthorised access or a compromised account.

sections.heading: Resolution 1
sections.text: Security reports are handled by the security team; support agents escalate every report immediately.
